layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol (Tetris Mode for Marketing, Control Room for Admin)

components.navigation: Glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) with 1px border-b border-black/5. Must be sticky top-0 z-50.
components.buttons: Rounded-full for main CTAs. Primary is #8C6A5D. Hover effect: scale up slightly, increase shadow. Active: scale down.
components.cards: Neumorphic / clay style. Background matches page, soft shadow-lg, 1px border-white/50 inner highlight.
components.admin_panel: Dense layout, strictly functional. Use Shadcn UI Tables, Tabs, and Cards. Spacing should be tighter here (p-4 to p-6).
components.shopping_cart: Use Shadcn Sheet (side drawer). Clean list of items, sticky checkout button at the bottom.
components.chat_interface: Use flex-col with overflow-y-auto. Messages from self aligned right (primary color), others left (muted color).
components.instagram_feed: Grid cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4. Images should have group-hover:scale-105 transition inside overflow-hidden containers.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons/cards must have transition-transform duration-300 ease-out.
motion_and_interactions.page_load: Framer motion staggered fade-up for hero and grid items.
motion_and_interactions.scrolling: Consider Lenis smooth scroll for the marketing side of the app (home, menu, bookstore).

hero_background.description: Cozy cafe interior with bookshelves and seating areas.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the hero section uses an overlay of bg-black/40 so the text remains legible over the background image.
Implement Google Maps or OpenStreetMap using a react-leaflet or similar component in the Map section.
Use standard Shadcn components for the Admin panel: Sidebar, Tables, Tabs, Cards, Badges.
Set data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (e.g., add-to-cart-btn, login-submit-btn).
Make sure forms (login, checkout, admin chat) use controlled React components and Shadcn Forms.
Apply Cormorant Garamond font to all headings (h1, h2, h3). Apply Manrope to body and UI text.
